translations.key: The demo usage limit has been reached. Read saved text for now.
translations.yo: Iye lílo ìdánwò ti dé ààlà rẹ̀. Ka ọ̀rọ̀ tí o ti fipamọ́ fún ìsinsìnyí.
translations.ha: An kai iyakar amfani da demo. Ka karanta rubutun da ka adana a yanzu.
translations.ig: Eruola oke ojiji ngosi. Gụọ ederede echekwara ugbu a.

translations.key: Your learning history and locally saved lessons will be removed. Files you downloaded separately stay on your device.
translations.yo: Ìtàn ẹ̀kọ́ rẹ àti àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ tí o ti fipamọ́ sí ẹ̀rọ rẹ ni a óò yọ kúrò. Àwọn fáìlì tí o ṣe ìgbàsílẹ̀ lọ́tọ̀ yóò dúró lórí ẹ̀rọ rẹ.
translations.ha: Za a cire tarihin koyonka da darussan da aka adana a na'urarka. Fayilolin da ka sauke daban za su ci gaba da kasancewa a na'urarka.
translations.ig: A ga-ewepụ akụkọ mmụta gị na nkuzi echekwara na ngwaọrụ gị. Faịlụ ndị i budatara iche ga-anọgide na ngwaọrụ gị.

translations.key: Anonymous usage counts remain for 31 days to enforce demo limits. They contain no learning text or recordings.
translations.yo: Àwọn ìṣirò lílo aláìlórúkọ yóò wà fún ọjọ́ 31 láti fi mú àwọn ààlà ìdánwò ṣẹ. Wọn kò ní ọ̀rọ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ tàbí àkọsílẹ̀ ohùn kankan.
translations.ha: Ƙididdigar amfani marasa suna za su kasance na kwanaki 31 domin aiwatar da iyakokin demo. Ba su ƙunshi rubutun koyo ko rikodin sauti ba.
translations.ig: Ọnụọgụ ojiji na-enweghị aha ga-adịru ụbọchị 31 iji hụ na a na-edebe oke ngosi. Ha enweghị ederede mmụta ma ọ bụ ndekọ olu ọ bụla.

translations.key: Your learning is removed after 30 days of inactivity.
translations.yo: A óò yọ data ẹ̀kọ́ rẹ kúrò lẹ́yìn ọjọ́ 30 láìsí ìṣe kankan.
translations.ha: Za a share bayanan koyonka bayan kwanaki 30 ba tare da amfani ba.
translations.ig: A ga-ehichapụ data mmụta gị mgbe ụbọchị 30 nke enweghị ọrụ gasịrị.
